entities.summary: The Intergovernmental Authority on Development (IGAD) is a trade bloc in Africa. It includes governments from the Horn of Africa, Nile Valley and the African Great Lakes. It is headquartered in Djibouti. Intergovernmental Authority on Development is a intergovernmental organization, arising around 1986.
